pattern: verification supplies explicit current task identity
experience: A delayed verification must not inherit whichever criteria or run happens to be current when it is submitted.
rule: Submit the expected criteria version and run ID explicitly; a passing verifier verdict is not independent proof that tests were rerun.
prompt: I verified task-1 against the displayed acceptance criteria in run-current. Record a passing verification for criterion works with a concise summary and evidence saying the focused test passed. Do not claim Plotline independently ran the test.
